items.title: Stock-market bubble versus public funding
items.body: Whether the bubble bursts is a question for investors, not for the NHS, but a 20 to 30 per cent correction would reduce the value of private pensions many clinicians hold. Public spending on digital tools is unaffected directly. A credit crisis would be a different matter, and both commentators agree that is the more dangerous path.

items.title: Supplier risk behind AI scribes
items.body: Both positions agree that revenue is concentrated in a few labs and that many AI companies are venture-funded. A scribe or triage product built on such a start-up carries the risk that prices rise or the firm folds. Ask for data export, exit terms and a named fallback in any contract.

items.title: Data centres in the UK
items.body: Microsoft cancelled an Essex data centre over grid delays, which is relevant to anyone hoping for UK-hosted AI services. UK data residency may stay scarce and costly for some time.
